eps.o: History is made as Shawn Michaels welcomes the next generation of WWE prospects to WWE Evolve.
Aerial standouts Oro Mensah and Riley Osborne make their WWE EVOLVE debuts. Wendy Choo looks to put Aria Bennett to sleep.
Joe and Mark Coffey of Gallus continue their path of destruction through WWE EVOLVE. Luca Crusifino looks to handle business against Javier Bernal.
A major announcement changes the trajectory of WWE EVOLVE. Sean Legacy sets out to establish himself against a former OG EVOLVE Champion.
In a double main event, Joe Coffey faces the tough-as-nails Harlem Lewis while Kylie Rae confronts her fears against Wendy Choo.
Following their loss in tag team action, Dani Palmer and Kali Armstrong finally clash. Riley Osborne and Javier Bernal go toe-to-toe.
Kali Armstrong, Kendal Grey, Brinley Reece and Chantel Monroe clash in a Fatal 4-Way Match. The Meta-Four's Oro Mensah battles Javier Bernal.
Timothy Thatcher goes one-on-one with The Vanity Project's Bryce Donovan. "Super" Sean Legacy collides with Jackson Drake.
Kylie Rae puts her fears aside when she battles the sinister Wendy Choo. The unlikely duo of Keanu Carver and Harlem Lewis face Swipe Right.
WWE EVOLVE General Manager Stevie Turner makes a major announcement. Nikkita Lyons faces Kendal Grey. The devious Wendy Choo is in action.
Two EVOLVE upstarts Keanu Carver and Harlem Lewis join forces to battle Gallus' Joe and Mark Coffey. Lexis King tangles with Sean Legacy.
Keanu Carver and Harlem Lewis collide in the most anticipated matchup in WWE EVOLVE history. Edris Enofé makes his WWE EVOLVE in-ring debut.
A Fatal 4-Way Elimination Match between Wendy Choo, Kendal Grey, Kylie Rae and Kali Armstrong crowns the first-ever WWE EVOLVE Women’s Champion.
The inaugural WWE EVOLVE Champion emerges from a Fatal 4-Way Elimination Match featuring Keanu Carver, Sean Legacy, Jackson Drake, and Edris Enofé.
New WWE EVOLVE Champion Jackson Drake celebrates his historic title victory. Cappuccino Jones looks to overcome the odds against Wes Lee.
Kali Armstrong teams up with Natalya to combat Nikkita Lyons and Zayda Steel. Jordan Oasis and Marcus Mathers meet in a WWE ID Showcase Match.
WWE EVOLVE hosts a Last Woman Standing Match for the first time ever, pitting Kylie Rae against Wendy Choo. Keanu Carver faces Ice Williams.
Natalya and Kali Armstrong arrive for their in-ring contract signing. The Vanity Project battle Cruz Del Toro, Joaquin Wilde and Lince Dorado.
Natalya challenges Kali Armstrong for the WWE EVOLVE Women’s Title. Keanu Carter directs his WWE ID Program rampage at Timothy Thatcher.
Jackson Drake puts the WWE EVOLVE Men's Championship on the line for the first time against veteran luchador Lince Dorado.
A mystery partner joins Jordan Oasis for a tag team showdown against Swipe Right. Kendal Grey and Zayda Steel square off.
WWE EVOLVE Women’s Champion Kali Armstrong sends a message to Jin Tala. Keanu Carter targets WWE ID standout Sean Legacy.
The undefeated Jin Tala challenges Kali Armstrong in an EVOLVE Women’s Title Match. Carlee Bright seeks retribution on Wendy Choo.
An EVOLVE Women’s Title Eliminator Match pits Tyra Mae Steele against Karmen Petrovic. Dante Chen and Edris Enofé meet again.
"Super" Sean Legacy steps up to the veteran Ridge Holland. Kylie Rae and Chantel Monroe clash in an Evolve Women's Title Eliminator Match.
Kali Armstrong defends the EVOLVE Women's Championship in a massive Fatal 4-Way Match against Chantel Monroe, Karmen Petrovic and Nikkita Lyons.
EVOLVE Prime Minister Stevie Turner makes a monumental announcement regarding the next No. 1 Contender for Jackson Drake's EVOLVE Championship.
Jackson Drake defends the EVOVLE Championship with the odds stacked against him in a Triple Threat Match against Brooks Jensen and Keanu Carver.
Wendy Choo and Kendal Grey make history in EVOLVE's first ever "I Quit" Match. The Vanity Project sound off inside the EVOLVE ring.
EVOLVE Prime Minister Stevie Turner makes a historic announcement regarding the Men's and Women's EVOLVE Championships.
Keanu Carver and Brooks Jensen go one-on-one to determine the No. 1 Contender to the EVOLVE Championship.
WWE EVOLVE Champion Jackson Drake hosts a contract signing to determine the No. 1 Contender for his title match at EVOLVE Succession.
The biggest night in EVOLVE history emanates from NXT Arena with the Men’s and Women’s WWE EVOLVE Championships on the line.
Following WWE EVOLVE: Succession, bitter rivals collide when "Super" Sean Legacy finally tangles with Edris Enofe.
Tate Wilder, Laredo Kid and Marcus Mathers collide in a triple threat showdown representing the WWE Performance Center, AAA and WWE ID.
Adrenaline Drip and the duo of Harley Riggins and Jax Presley run it back one more time in a must-win rubber match.
Keanu Carver looks to seize the biggest opportunity of his career by attempting to dethrone Jackson Drake as WWE EVOLVE Champion.
Kali Armstrong strives to overcome EVOLVE's newest powerhouse PJ Vasa. Tate Wilder & Trill London collide with Swipe Right.
Newly crowned WWE EVOLVE Women's Champion Kendal Grey makes her first title defense on EVOLVE against a familiar foe in Chantel Monroe.
"Super" Sean Legacy and Tate Wilder collide in an explosive No. 1 Contender's Match for the WWE EVOLVE Championship.
Competitors from the WWE Performance Center and WWE ID program battle for supremacy in a 5-on-5 Gauntlet Match.
The Vanity Project's Jackson Drake defends the WWE Evolve Title in a championship rematch against a relentless rival in "Super" Sean Legacy.
Kendal Grey defends the WWE Evolve Women's Championship with the odds stacked against her in a Triple Threat Match against Kali Armstrong and PJ Vasa.
A new-look Wendy Choo is ready to make a massive challenge. Karmen Petrovic looks to prove herself in a fierce matchup against Kali Armstrong.
With Team PC in control for tonight's show, WWE Evolve Champion Jackson Drake has the odds stacked against him in a 3-on-1 Handicap Match.
Team PC upstart Kam Hendrix receives his opportunity to challenge Jackson Drake for the WWE Evolve Championship.
Karmen Petrovic steps up for the biggest opportunity of her career by challenging Kendal Grey for the WWE Evolve Women's Championship.
Kendal Grey and PJ Vasa sign the contract for their WWE Evolve Women's Championship Match at Evolve Succession II.
The heated rivalry between Team PC and Team WWE ID comes to a breaking point when members from each side collide in a 10-Man Tag Team Match.
